# checker

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/checker"
```

Package checker checks TGo source before lowering.

A propagation expression has the call's success types. The checker must know those types while it checks outer calls, assignments, and returns. This avoids rewriting files and loading packages for each operator.

The loader checks module dependencies first and caches each package identity. Test variants keep separate identities. External dependencies use compiled exports read with the same private Go types as the source checker.

Stock Go objects remain in the public Load API. Private checking uses separate objects with the same ordinary syntax. Lowering uses only the private objects. Go checks the emitted module after all source packages have passed checking.

Run make prepare to generate the pinned Go sources from the tracked patch.

## type Loader

Loader checks module packages and imports compiled dependencies. Every package uses the same private type universe.

```go
type Loader struct {
    Root     string
    TGoFiles map[string]string
    Used     map[string]bool
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

NewLoader records dependency exports before any source package is checked. Every source check uses the module's selected Go target architecture.
